name: H. S. India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, H S India Ltd is in the business of Hotels and Restaurants[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company operates a 3-star hotel under the name Lords Plaza and has entered into an agreement with Lords INN Hotels and Developers Limited to help in Operating, Managing, Marketing and advertisement.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.63 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.77% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.21% over last 3 years.
